verdict.rationale: Fin has a documented public Fin Agent API for programmatic invocation, plus a broader Intercom REST API and official Node SDK confirmed live via runtime probes (auth-gated endpoints returning proper error responses), and MCP server access is also documented and verified live. missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found 404s) and no independent third-party integration report beyond first-party docs/probes.
